surface.hint: Faces of a solid that have their own colour in the file. Drag a material here or use “Assign to selection”; in the 3D view, drag a material onto the face while holding Alt. Move/rotate via the part.

selection.hint: {parts} – “Assign to selection” replaces the material on all of them. Shift+click: add/remove, Ctrl+A: all, A: frame, H: hide.
selection.noTransform: Move/rotate only works on whole parts, not on a material selection.

transform.hiddenHint: Hidden – show it first to move, rotate or scale it.

splatLook.title: Splat appearance

splatLook.dropHint: Drag a material from the list onto the splats to tint them (base colour, metal, roughness, glow)
splatLook.removeTitle: Remove the splat material – back to their own colours
splatLook.detailTitle: How much of the splats' brightness shows through the material colour (0 = plain, 1 = as captured)

quality.label: Quality

slicer.inactiveHint: Tick the box in the Scene Graph to activate.

camera.fovTitle: Field of view (vertical). Above {limit}° the picture turns smoothly into a fisheye.

dof.label: DOF

dof.targetTitle: Put the focus plane through the camera pivot

dof.titleSplats: Depth of field (live, also while orbiting)

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.typeTitle: How the materials' textures are laid onto this object – applies to all parts below it unless they have their own
mapping.scaleTitle: Factor on the material's tile size: 2 = texture twice as large
mapping.inheritHint: A change gives this object its own mapping.

belowHint.one: {count} part below has its own mapping – a change here replaces it.
belowHint.other: {count} parts below have their own mapping – a change here replaces them.

style.title: Style filter
style.modeTitle: Lays a look over the finished picture – in every view mode, also in the image export and the AI image

lens.title: Lens effects
lens.bloomThresholdTitle: Brightness (linear, before tone mapping) above which bloom starts – 1 = white
lens.glareThresholdTitle: Brightness (linear, before tone mapping) above which rays appear – 1 = white
lens.shaftsLengthTitle: How far around the model the air glows
lens.shaftsFocusTitle: How much the rays light up towards the sun (0 = even)
lens.shaftsTitle: Rays of the HDRI sun through the air – the model casts shadow wedges
lens.flareTitle: Lens reflections of the sun (ghosts, halo, glow) – same light source as the light shafts (brightest spot of the HDRI); they disappear when the model covers the sun (seen from the camera), partially covered = fainter

view.saveTitle: Save the current camera view (position, target, field of view, depth of field) – appears below “Camera” in the Scene Graph
view.name: Name

view.multiHint: Several views selected (Shift+click to add/remove). Del deletes all.

page.title: RINDR – 3D viewer with path tracing in the browser
page.description: Open STEP, glTF, FBX, MAX, 3MF, STL, BIM (IFC, BCF) and Gaussian splats right in the browser – local, no upload, with material library and real-time path tracing.
page.ogImageAlt: RINDR logo (cow head) with the caption “3D viewer in the browser”

drop.title: Drop file here
drop.hint: STEP (.stp/.step), glTF/GLB, FBX, MAX (.max), 3MF, USD (.usd/.usdz), STL, PLY, BIM (.ifc/.ifczip), BCF issues (.bcfzip), Gaussian splats (.ply/.sog) – just drop textures and .bin files along with it
drop.addHint: Several models: drop them together or one after another – they appear side by side
drop.replaceHint: The loaded models are removed and replaced by the new file
drop.addSplitHint: The new file appears in addition, next to the existing models
drop.relinkHint: The files are matched to the missing textures or files of the scene by their names
drop.splatNote: Gaussian splats (.ply/.sog) become the surroundings – the models are placed into the scan

about.title: About
about.description: Your Local 3D-File Viewer – STEP, glTF, FBX, MAX, 3MF, USD, STL, BIM (IFC, BCF) and Gaussian splats right in the browser, with real-time path tracing.
about.author: Author
about.openSource: RINDR is built on great open-source projects. Thanks to everyone who contributes to them!

libs.bvh: Acceleration structures for raycasting and path tracing
libs.oidnWeb: Open Image Denoise in the browser
libs.openHdri: HDRI maps for lighting and background
libs.coi: Cross-origin isolation on GitHub Pages (fast loading of large files)

large.title: Very large model
large.message: “{name}” has {triangles} triangles. It probably needs more memory than this device gives the browser – the view may become slow or the tab may crash.

file.title: Very large file
file.message: “{name}” is very large for the memory of this device. Even reading it may take the browser to its limit.

limit.title: Model too large for this device

safe.title: Safe mode
safe.message: “{name}” is opened with less memory this time: coarser tessellation and less work in parallel.

crash.title: Last load was interrupted
crash.message: While opening “{name}” the browser ended the tab – most likely it ran out of memory. Next time rindr opens it more sparingly.
crash.messageDrop: While opening “{name}” the browser ended the tab – most likely it ran out of memory. Drop the file again: rindr then opens it more sparingly.

fbxStatic.title: Loaded without animation
fbxStatic.message: “{name}” is too large for the full FBX import in the browser. Geometry, materials and textures are there – animations, skinning and blend shapes were not loaded.

hqUnsupported.title: HQ not available
hqUnsupported.message: Path tracing needs WebGPU. This browser or graphics card does not support it – the view stays in Default.
hqUnsupported.blocked: The browser is currently not providing the graphics card for WebGPU – usually after a graphics card reset. Close the browser completely (all windows) and start it again. If it stays like this, graphics card or driver do not support WebGPU (status in Chrome: chrome://gpu). Until then the view stays in Default.

lost.title: Graphics card was reset
lost.message: The graphics card was busy with one task for too long and was reset by the system – rendering has stopped. After reloading, rindr computes in smaller portions.

recovered.title: Graphics card ready again
recovered.message: Before the reload the graphics card was reset. rindr computes in smaller portions for this session. The details help to find the cause.

outliers.message: “{name}” contains geometry far outside or far larger than the rest of the model (up to {size}) – probably a helper object or an export error. It is hidden and ignored for centring, camera and ground.
